caption: The drawing consists of twelve rectangles arranged in a grid, with three rows and four columns, centered on a beige background. Each rectangle contains a different hand-drawn pattern using shades of brown ink. The patterns vary in style: the top row has vertical herringbone lines, zigzag and wave-like lines, small oval dots, and wavy parallel lines. The second row contains a floral or leafy vine with dots, repeating arrow or chevron-shaped marks, a texture resembling scales or overlapping shapes, and parallel wavy lines. The bottom row displays a pattern of dots in a grid, diagonal crosshatching resembling a woven texture, a meandering looping line with dots, and a tight crosshatch forming a basket-weave appearance. All patterns are drawn with brown ink, and the bottom right corner includes a handwritten signature.
title: Textiles
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
